question: For the exactly frozen BTCI v8.17.1 684 Sunday dates, how many would have a genuinely first-available daily MVRV at decision time as opposed to retrospectively backfilled history or source-file old Git timestamps?
hypothesis: Prior v8.18c3 Git-vintage sources are useful candidate inputs but NOT proven original public first-seen on historical signal dates. Strict gate must not silently treat git commit timestamps, fork creation or 2019 rows in 2020 archive as availability proofs.

study.conservativeObservationGuard: at least two calendar days before Sunday; use Friday or older daily data, no same-Sunday nor Saturday
study.cohort: EXACT 684 frozen Sundays, no outcomes or price relabeling, no date additions/removals
study.candidateDefinition: an earlier archive commit with MVRV available on a daily row from Friday or earlier within 7d of the Sunday and not earlier than its own commit date; this is only a Git-vintage candidate, not original PIT
study.strictSourceCriterion: Original public first-seen record and exact metric/data definition and value, plus available_at UTC before Sunday decision; reconstructed CSV, historic Git object alone or Jan 1 2020 rounded article with observed-date mismatch NOT sufficient.
study.strictGate: If no independently verified original public first-seen timestamps with exact aligned value, strictEligible=false and no backtesting. Do NOT declare all MVRV unavailable; unknown, not proven.
study.decoupledContext: 2018 MVRV concept public; archived July 2018 schema absent. 2020 article 1.33 matches Dec29 but printed Dec30, date mapping unverified; do not upgrade.
study.summaries: exact 684 panel rows with time/source eligibility flags, per-era counts, nearest preserved vintage sample coverage, hard gap/quality states, report negative evidence and limitations.
study.noModeling: No signals, threshold tuning, model fitting, historic predictive accuracy, OOS claims or trading recommendations
study.license: Coin Metrics CC BY-NC: do not redistribute full raw original CSV; archive eligibility metadata only.

quality: Verify source raw Git SHA1, R2 pinned parent SHA256, original panel count/date ordering and Sunday, R2 SHA256 read-back; on any source failure classify failure, do not impute or downgrade guard.
